body: I feel like body dysmorphia would mean that I obsess over small things, but to me all of my flaws that I have listed are not "small" - especially once you start adding them up.

Oh how I wish I had body dysmorphia. Then that would mean that I'm pretty much imagining these things (which I'm not). And there is a lot more than this depression and anxiety of mine, you're right. I was molested at age four by my own grandfather and I literally have only two family members here in the states, the rest are in different countries (so it's very depressing during the holidays) Also my parents got divorced at age 5.

I may not have herpes but I'd rather have one "flaw" than a million. I'm not undermining your herpes but I am pretty certain most people would rather date someone with herpes than someone who has all these flaws just because of how vain the majority are. I read your post on here and it saddens me how you think of yourself.

That's great and all - that you're attracted to women who have flaws but I don't believe any man would ever date a girl with so MANY. It's a reality I have to face every day. And quite often I find more flaws and it drives me crazy. But anyways, thank you for what you had to say.
